detail.longDescription: Bayelsa State Governor, Senator DouyeDiri, has unveiled Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered robotic tutors and other digital learning innovations at the Bayelsa Medical University (BMU), Yenagoa, as part of efforts to advance medical education, research and technological development in the state. The Tide reports that the innovations were unveiled on Monday alongside the university’s 2025–2029 Strategic Plan, […]
